## Scope

The audit covered 432 second reads taken this quarter. It considered the relationship between the first and second grades for the sets included in the review. The scope was confined to those second reads and the corresponding grading comparison. No additional material is included in this summary.

The supporting record is available in the attached spreadsheet. It provides the per-grader results for the audit and should be read alongside this document where further detail is required.

## Result

First and second grades agreed in 63.7 per cent of sets. This is the overall agreement result for the audited material. The per-grader results are set out in the attached spreadsheet and are discussed with each grader privately. These discussions provide the appropriate setting for reviewing individual results and any points arising from them.
